title: Signal Mesh: Adaptive Model Landscape Prioritization Hub
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: We lack a single, queryable surface that fuses continuous signals (model performance deltas, license changes, latency/cost benchmarks, vendor availability) into prioritized recommendations for PM/Eng/Procurement. Current ad-hoc spreadsheets and PRs cause duplicated scouting work and slow reaction to model regressions or procurement opportunities.

Goal: Build a lightweight "Signal Mesh" and Prioritization Hub that ingests model-landscape signals, scores and clusters models by strategic impact, and surfaces triage actions and procurement triggers. This ticket scopes a product-first MVP: data schema, scoring rubric, prioritized UI rows (console + internal dashboard), and notification hooks for critical changes.

Scope (MVP):
- Define a normalized model signal schema and ingestion paths (release notes scraping, open-model registries, benchmark uploads, partner reports).
- Create a scoring rubric combining: capability delta, cost/latency delta, availability risk, license/compliance risk, and enterprise fit.
- Build prioritized list view and API endpoint for other teams (console + scoutbot).
- Wire webhook/Slack alerting for high-severity signals and procurement-suggested triggers.
- Provide export to procurement playbook (CSV + annotated evidence).

Out of scope: full vendor negotiation workflow, automated procurement, deep ML eval pipelines (these are separate follow-ups).
acceptance_criteria: Signal schema documented and published in Drive with examples
Automated ingestion pipelines ingest at least 3 signal sources (release-scraper, open-registry feed, bench-upload) into test index
Prioritization API returns stable score and top-10 ranked models for a given vertical query
Console internal dashboard shows top 20 prioritized models with change deltas and evidence links
Webhook alerts generated for high-severity events and delivered to #model-scouts Slack channel
tasks: PM: finalize scoring weights and vertical-specific overrides (Aisha)
ENG: build prioritization microservice and API (ENG-21900)
Design: dashboard wireframes and prioritization row affordances (DES-1407)
Data: connect bench-upload ETL and map latency/cost fields
Ops: setup alpha Slack webhook + permissioned alerting channel
Legal: flag models with unclear licensing for manual review
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: noisy signals create false positives -> Mitigation: require 2-source corroboration before high-severity alert
Risk: scoring biases against niche models -> Mitigation: allow manual adjustment and audit log of score changes
Risk: ingestion rate limits from external registries -> Mitigation: cache and backoff policy, request whitelist for partner feeds
Risk: data privacy for customer-contributed benchmarks -> Mitigation: anonymize uploads and require consent checkbox
success_metrics: Time-to-identify high-risk model regressions reduced from 7 days to <=24 hours
Scout team triage throughput increased by 40% for prioritized items
Number of procurement opportunities surfaced per quarter >= 3 with annotated ROI estimates
False positive alert rate < 8% after 2 weeks of live traffic
